connectionSpecification.description: Reads CSV, TSV, JSONL and Parquet files from Google Cloud Storage, one stream per glob: full refresh, or incremental by object modification time.

bucket.description: Name of the bucket, without gs://.
bucket.title: Bucket

credentials.description: How the connector authenticates to Google Cloud.

oneOf.description: The JSON key of a service account.

service_account_info.description: The JSON key of the service account, as the Google Cloud console downloads it. The account needs storage.objects.list and storage.objects.get on the bucket, as the Storage Object Viewer role grants.
service_account_info.title: Service Account Information

oneOf.title: Service Account Key

oneOf.description: Google Cloud Application Default Credentials: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS, gcloud's user credentials, GKE Workload Identity or the metadata server of a Compute Engine instance.
oneOf.title: Application Default Credentials

credentials.title: Credentials

compression.description: auto: by the name's extension (.gz, .zst), then by the first bytes; none, gzip or zstd: always that.
compression.title: Compression

format.description: File format of the stream's objects.

oneOf.description: Delimited text with a header row; values with the delimiter, quotes or line breaks are quoted.

column_names.description: Column names in file order. Required without a header row; with one they replace its names.
column_names.title: Column Names

escape_char.description: Character that makes the next character literal, inside or outside quotes. Empty: none.
escape_char.title: Escape Character

header.description: Whether the first row (after skip_rows) names the columns.
header.title: Header Row

null_values.description: Unquoted values read as null. A quoted value is never null.
null_values.title: Null Values

quote_char.description: Character that quotes a field holding the delimiter, line breaks or quotes; a doubled quote inside stands for one. Empty: fields are never quoted.
quote_char.title: Quote Character

skip_rows.description: Lines to skip at the start of each file, before the header.
skip_rows.title: Skip Rows

oneOf.title: CSV

oneOf.description: Tab-separated text; by default no quoting, so a field holds no tab or line break.

column_names.description: Column names in file order. Required without a header row; with one they replace its names.
column_names.title: Column Names

escape_char.description: Character that makes the next character literal, inside or outside quotes. Empty: none.
escape_char.title: Escape Character

header.description: Whether the first row (after skip_rows) names the columns.
header.title: Header Row

null_values.description: Unquoted values read as null. A quoted value is never null.
null_values.title: Null Values

quote_char.description: Character that quotes a field holding the delimiter, line breaks or quotes; a doubled quote inside stands for one. Empty: fields are never quoted.
quote_char.title: Quote Character

skip_rows.description: Lines to skip at the start of each file, before the header.
skip_rows.title: Skip Rows

oneOf.title: TSV

format.title: Format

glob.description: Object names the stream reads: * matches within one path segment, ** across segments, ? one character, {a,b} alternatives. The part before the first wildcard is the listing prefix.
glob.title: Glob

schema.description: JSON schema of the records, an object schema with properties. Empty: inferred from the newest files.
schema.title: Schema

schema_sample_files.description: How many of the newest matching files the schema is inferred from.
schema_sample_files.title: Schema Sample Files

skip_bad_rows.description: Skip rows that cannot be parsed or do not fit the schema, and log how many per file, instead of failing the read.
skip_bad_rows.title: Skip Bad Rows

connectionSpecification.title: Google Cloud Storage Source Spec
